dedupe_keys.name: petabencana id real time crowdsourced disaster map

description: PetaBencana.id is a real-time disaster information system for Indonesia that collects crowdsourced reports, largely through social media and chat bots, of floods and other hazards and publishes them on an open live map. It grew out of the PetaJakarta.org flood project and is run and maintained by Yayasan Peta Bencana, the Disaster Map Foundation, to support community-led disaster risk reduction; the foundation reports over 900 humanitarian organisations using its data in 2024. Coverage is national for Indonesia, report by report in real time since 2017. Format and access: the live web map is public, and open and customised APIs are provided on request with data training. Licence: not stated on the pages read; use of the map is free. Caveats: crowdsourced reports are uneven in space and over-represent connected users, the pages read give no schema or archive download, and access to historical data needs contact with the team. It provides observed flood extents and service disruption reports for emergency response, hazard exposure and resilience studies, including validation of urban flood models. Related catalogue records are the NYC 311 service requests and Ushahidi, other citizen-report sources.
